svg.aria-label: Constructed design diagnostics. A fixes initial protein at 20 micromolar, n=1 and enthalpy at −40 kJ/mol while changing Kᴅ. B fixes n=1 and colors the RMS injection-heat residual; the white cross marks its grid minimum. Colors are not confidence regions.
